result:
I couldn't start the research worker: the launcher refused it twice with the same error, so I stopped. Nothing is committed and no clone was made. The cause is an inline comment on the ticket's `allowed_paths` line, which only you can edit. Three other questions also block the ticket's success lines (S2 to S5) and are listed as packages P2 to P4 below.

task: DAEO-aks1 (W2-88b)
status: LAUNCH_BLOCKED (ticket `.tickets/DAEO-aks1.md` line 25: `allowed_paths` carries an inline comment that the launcher and guard read raw), plus packages P2 to P4 for the owner and the owner's operator
work_completed: Identity and location checked (orchestrator, DAEO-aks1; `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-88b` on `w2/W2-88b`); no checkpoint existed, so this was a fresh run. Read the ticket, the W2-88 ticket's S10, S12 and S15 lines and its `acceptance_tests.author` line, the practice doc §2, W2-88's evidence record and `proof_a_real.py`, and the launcher's and guard's rules for the runs folder. Checked network reach: both GitHub repositories answer `git ls-remote`. Took the F2 before-snapshot of `~/workspace` (reads only, `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0` so `git status` writes nothing there; run twice and stable). Built the research worker's context with `gov context --budget 20000`, wrote its brief, and attempted the launch twice; both were refused (below). Made the empty folder `experiments/W2-88/`, which the launcher needs; it is untracked.
files_changed: none committed. Lead scratch (untracked): `.gov-runtime/scratch/lead/{CHECKPOINT.md, briefs/rs-1.md, context-research.md, snapshot.py, f2-workspace-before.json, log/rs-1*.{json,exit}}`; empty folder `experiments/W2-88/`
evidence: Both launches refused with "the research ticket's allowed_paths is not exactly one experiment folder (DEC-242)" (`launch_worker` dry run, `src/gov/launch/launcher.py:191`). The cause: `_load_ticket` returns `allowed_paths: ['experiments/W2-88/**  # the one folder a research worker writes (DEC-996 (3) C); the proof record is here']`, so `experiment_folder()` gives None (`src/gov/guard/install.py:204-209`); this is the same failure W2-94 had (fixed by acaaf1f1f). F2 baseline of `~/workspace`: 52,285 paths, mtime digest `b63f4c31030120c9…`, HEAD `621f6a907ac3`, `git status` empty. `gov links --since 31eab2103`: "gov links: 0 new since 31eab2103, 1751 standing (…)". `gov.__file__` = `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-88b/src/gov/__init__.py`
tests: none run. This is a research ticket with no `tests/acceptance/W2-88b`; I started no test designer, following the CTO's order (research worker, then the narrow check)
discoveries: (1) Workers cannot run the real proofs: the sandbox has no network and no real embedder or reranker (EMG-d4b-launched.md). So I will make the clones and run the real A9 runs outside the sandbox, as W2-88's lead ran `proof_a_real.py`; the worker writes `experiments/W2-88/proof_bc.py` and the record. (2) The guard lets this ticket write only its own runs folder `~/gov-os-runs/W2-88b/` (`src/gov/guard/runs.py:118`, `decide.py:166` and `1211`), not the ticket's `~/gov-os-runs/W2-88/`; that folder exists only once a worker launch has made it. (3) The 10 questions per real repository belong to "sessions outside the system opened by the owner's operator" (DAEO-2bdu `acceptance_tests.author`, under DEC-1099 (2)), so the lead cannot open them. (4) Pins as of 2026-11-13: redis/redis `ee8e7f70152404649ac947157fd662d11b4a00d5` (unstable, 221 MB; the API gives the licence as NOASSERTION, so the record will read its LICENSE files); grafana/grafana `a00ff430d41e74022eb54361c9741e224e150021` (main, 2.1 GB, AGPL-3.0). (5) DEC-1156 (7) and DEC-1099 (2) are cited here but are not in `sources:`.
risks: A9 with the real embedder on grafana (of the order of 10^4 files, all embedded as in proof (a)) could take hours. W2-88's lower bound is 0.04 s a chunk, and legacy-docs did not finish in an hour. I will run MA first and bring its estimate before the A9 runs. A re-run of A9 is needed once the questions exist, because `--questions` is an A9 input.
lessons: An inline comment on a ticket field the launcher reads (`allowed_paths`) blocks a research launch, as `role:` did for W2-94. `depends_on` line 20 carries one too.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved:
- **P1 (CTO).** Question: remove the inline comments from `.tickets/DAEO-aks1.md` lines 20 and 25? Options: (a) make them `- DAEO-2bdu` and `- experiments/W2-88/**` and move the notes into the body, as acaaf1f1f did (about 2 min); (b) the CTO sets `LAUNCH_CODE_ROOT` (does not help: the ticket parse is the same). Recommendation: (a). Confidence: high. Blocks: every worker launch.
- **P2 (owner, or the CTO under DEC-1156 (7)).** Question: where do the clones go? S2, S3, F1 and F2 name `~/gov-os-runs/W2-88/`, but the guard allows only `~/gov-os-runs/W2-88b/`. Options: (a) clones under `~/gov-os-runs/W2-88b/{github,workspace,workbench}/<name>/` (the CTO's brief already says W2-88b), with the record stating the path and the reason (cost: none); (b) an ACT that opens W2-88's folder to this ticket (a guard change, hours). Recommendation: (a). Confidence: high. Blocks: the path wording of S2, S3, F1 and F2 at review.
- **P3 (owner's operator).** Question: who makes the workbench clones? Agents never read the workbench (DEC-723). Options: (a) the operator runs `git clone --no-hardlinks` of a-dev (ORION), b-dev (ARGUS), EXAMIN's copy and, only if it lies outside the held-out qualification material (the operator states which), ARGUS's stress tier, into `~/gov-os-runs/W2-88b/workbench/<name>/`, and records the mtimes of the workbench, EXAMIN's real repository and the qualification material before and after, for F1 (about 15 min); (b) proof (c) on `~/workspace` only, with the four named as not used and the shortfall accepted as a residual by the owner; (c) EXAMIN's assessment left to W2-27. Recommendation: (a). Confidence: medium. Blocks: S3, and S4 and S5 for those repositories.
- **P4 (owner's operator).** Question: who writes the 10 questions for each real repository (grafana, redis, `~/workspace`)? They must be written under the rubric by the independent writer and checker, sessions the operator opens. Options: (a) the operator opens them with the approved briefs (ACT-EXAMIN-WRITERS-INSTALL-1's) and delivers `w2-88-questions/1` files plus the writer's and checker's records under `~/gov-os-runs/W2-88b/questions/` (operator time, about 6 sessions, then one A9 re-run per repository); (b) A9 without questions, so the measure is null with the residual "questions"; S5's verify is not met unless the owner accepts that as a residual. Recommendation: (a), with A9 run now without questions and re-run when they arrive. Confidence: medium. Blocks: S5.
recommended_next_action: The CTO applies P1 and answers P2, then resumes this lead with the CHECKPOINT's NEXT line. I will launch rs-1, clone the two GitHub repositories and `~/workspace` (`--no-hardlinks`) into `~/gov-os-runs/W2-88b/`, run MA and bring its time estimate, then run A9 with the real embedder. P3 and P4 go to the owner's operator at the same time.
